2610.06425.title: SoK: Semantic Decision Engines in Network Control Loops
2610.06425.paper_summary: A semantic decision engine such as Jev can return a valid answer and still miss a network deadline, select an infeasible action or leave the service unverified. We systematize 139 paper families by decision interface, execution path and check ownership. Fifty families claim that their engine fits a control loop or time budget, but only four support the claim with matched measurement. Across all 139, four report deadline attainment. The gap concentrates where the decision has no deterministic computation step. Those 72 families make 22 of the claims, none supported, and name a coverage owner in only two. Bounded tests under one event model show that each gap can reverse an admission verdict. A decision that meets a 10 s budget for every isolated request meets it for none once decisions queue ahead of replayed execution times. The same engine passes one coverage check and fails another. We derive a minimum reporting record, design rules and a research agenda for admitting decision engines to control loops.
2610.06425.paper_summary_zh: 語義決策引擎如Jev可以返回有效答案，但仍然錯過網路截止時間，選擇不切實際的行動或使服務未經驗證。我們根據決策介面、執行路徑和檢查所有權系統化139個論文家族。五十個家族聲稱他們的引擎適合控制迴路或時間預算，但只有四個用匹配的測量支持這一主張。在所有139個中，只有四個報告了截止時間的達成。這一差距集中在決策沒有確定性計算步驟的地方。這72個家族提出了22項主張，沒有得到支持，並且只有兩個指定了覆蓋所有者。在一個事件模型下的有界測試顯示，每個差距都可以推翻入場裁決。對於每個孤立請求，符合10秒預算的決策在決策排隊於重播執行時間之前，對於任何請求都不符合。相同的引擎通過一項覆蓋檢查，但未通過另一項。我們推導出最小報告記錄、設計規則和研究議程，以便將決策引擎納入控制迴路。
